'''Samo's''' was a<ref name="Ever Been" /> bodega<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=news/andor-trivia-guide-week-2|text=Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 2 Trivia}}</ref> on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Ever Been" /> Samo's sold a variety of groceries and was a place for citizens to find the last-minute items they needed before dinner.<ref name="Databank" /> While living in a [[Axis network safehouse|safehouse]] on Coruscant, the rebels [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] and [[Bix Caleen]] shopped at Samo's. Caleen purchased three [[Unidentified Ukio melon|melons]] from the planet [[Ukio]] and also a spicy [[Moski pepper]].<ref name="Ever Been" />

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Samo's appeared in "[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]," the fourth episode of [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''.<ref name="Ever Been" /> Six months prior to the set's scheduled shoot date, set decoration department buyer [[Helen Player (person)|Helen Player]], began purchasing hundreds of items to stock the shelves of Samo's.<ref name="Trivia" />
